failure_modes.summary: unattended-upgrades can perform a kernel swap while an envelope is live
failure_modes.root_cause: The user namespace shares the host kernel, so a host upgrade can terminate processes without corrupting durable state.

failure_modes.summary: profile-runtime is currently on tmpfs and can disappear on restart
failure_modes.root_cause: Yazelix runtime state is bound to /run/user/1001 before the restart-gated XDG migration.

failure_modes.summary: home residuals can remain outside the profile-owned durable roots
failure_modes.root_cause: Legacy ~/.claude, ~/.codex, and ~/.local tool state may still be active owners until migration and restart.

failure_modes.summary: host docker or kvm surfaces could accidentally consume meta/var
failure_modes.root_cause: A broad bind or overlay lowerdir could make canonical durable state visible to a container runtime.

incident_2026_07_21.summary: The host kernel changed from the live session kernel and the host reboot ended processes while the filesystem remained intact.
timeline: 2026-07-21 21:28: active session processes were terminated during reboot
2026-07-21 21:29: durable filesystem and PostgreSQL/RuVector bytes remained intact
2026-07-21 21:30: the correct response was re-attach, not state reconstruction
